meta.scratchpad: Facilitator Mode is shipped. The tracker now includes the next collaborative-sync sequence and stretch backlog from ROADMAP.md, organized by swimlane and priority.

tasks.title: Phase 1: Canvas connection overlay foundation
tasks.goal: Render existing Connection records directly on the canvas as a bounded SVG overlay so relationships are visible without opening the drawer.
definition_of_done: Canvas renders up to 8-10 high-signal connections with style by kind.
Connected line endpoints update while an attached idea is being dragged.
Clicking a connection line highlights both endpoint ideas without breaking drag, group, or merge flows.
constraints: Reuse existing Connection records; do not introduce a new persisted connection model.
Keep the overlay non-intrusive and preserve current canvas interactions.

context.notes: Canvas now renders a bounded SVG connection overlay with drag-aware endpoints and click-to-highlight behavior.

tasks.title: Phase 1: Add draw_connection WebMCP tool
tasks.goal: Expose a WebMCP tool that creates a visible connection between two ideas in one call and routes through the same app state used by the canvas overlay.
tasks.comment: Keep this tool aligned with the existing dispatch-and-wait tool path; agents should be able to narrate and render the link in one action.
definition_of_done: A global draw_connection tool is registered and documented alongside find_connections.
Calling the tool results in a visible connection on the canvas.
Tool output clearly reports what was connected and how it was classified.
constraints: Do not add hidden coupling between the tool and future critique/timing systems.
Preserve the existing StrictMode-safe registration pattern.

context.notes: draw_connection is registered as a global WebMCP tool and threads through app-owned board connection state.

tasks.title: Phase 2: Persisted critique system
tasks.goal: Add the critique storage, WebMCP tools, and anchored critique-card UI so the app can challenge ideas sharply without interrupting flow.
tasks.comment: There is already a devilsAdvocate role in the phase pipeline, but this phase requires a separate persisted critique system with its own store, tools, and card UI.
definition_of_done: Critiques persist in a dedicated store and survive reloads.
critique_idea, list_critiques, and dismiss_critique are exposed through WebMCP.
Critique cards anchor near the target idea and never block interaction.
constraints: Critiques must appear only after idle and must not spam the board.
Critique phrasing should be sharp and specific rather than generic.

context.notes: Persisted critiques now have a dedicated IDB store, anchored canvas cards, and critique/list/dismiss WebMCP tools.

tasks.title: Phase 3: Soft mode inference timing layer
tasks.goal: Infer whether the board is exploring, structuring, stressing, or converging, then time AI actions subtly without adding explicit mode toggles.
tasks.comment: This phase should control timing, not decision authority. The UI cue must be subtle and fade if ignored.
definition_of_done: A lightweight inferredMode classifier exists with a reason and confidence.
Mode output drives the appropriate non-blocking suggestion or tool trigger path.
No mode toggle is added to the UI.
constraints: Never interrupt typing or dragging.
Only act after idle and never force a mode switch.

context.notes: Starting the timing layer after syncing completed facilitator slices.

tasks.title: Phase 4: Signal control and noise reduction
tasks.goal: Bound critiques, suggestions, and connections so the system stays trustworthy as more autonomous behavior lands.
tasks.comment: Do not scale broken signal. Thresholding and cooldowns should come after the underlying connection and critique signals are correct.
definition_of_done: Connection confidence threshold is enforced.
Per-idea critique cooldown prevents spam.
Suggestion deduplication and visible-count bounds keep the canvas clean.
constraints: Maximum 2 critiques per idea, 6 visible suggestions, and 10 connections total.
Keep all control logic aligned with the existing live board state.

tasks.title: Phase 5: Turn-log pagination
tasks.goal: Split large turn-log payloads out of get_idea so debugging and agent inspection scale without oversized responses.
tasks.comment: This is the observability sidecar the roadmap calls out for future connectionFinder and devilsAdvocate turn-log growth.
definition_of_done: get_turn_log returns paginated entries with nextCursor.
get_idea returns turn-log summary metadata instead of the full array.
Agent-side inspection can retrieve history incrementally.
constraints: Do not lose existing turn-log data.
Keep the new tool shape consistent with current WebMCP tool conventions.

tasks.title: Phase 6: Local autonomous facilitator
tasks.goal: Add bounded observer-driven automation so the system can add value without explicit user commands and without overwhelming the user.
tasks.comment: This remains local-only and should not start until the earlier facilitator phases are stable.
definition_of_done: State-change observers trigger bounded tool actions under explicit safeguards.
A global pause toggle exists.
AI-originated actions are tagged so the user can distinguish them from direct edits.
constraints: No sync or Yjs work starts here.
Human interruptibility must remain immediate.

tasks.title: Phase 7: Demo polish
tasks.goal: Refine animation timing, transitions, and layout so the facilitator behaviors read as intentional and impressive during the demo.
tasks.comment: This closes the sequence only after the earlier functional phases are working and stable.
definition_of_done: Connection, critique, and suggestion moments animate smoothly.
UI transitions avoid abrupt jumps.
The board reads as polished on desktop and mobile.
constraints: Do not hide unresolved functional issues with polish work.
Preserve the existing visual language rather than replacing it.

tasks.title: 3.1 Two-tab BroadcastChannel + Yjs sync spike
tasks.goal: Prove zero-server two-tab sync by wrapping the ideas store in a Y.Map with BroadcastChannel transport and y-indexeddb persistence.
tasks.comment: This is the first sync proof and the gate for broader CRDT or multi-peer work.
definition_of_done: Adding an idea in tab A appears in tab B in under 100ms on the same machine.
The ideas store is backed by a Y.Map with BroadcastChannel transport.
Reload preserves shared state through y-indexeddb while docs, suggestions, and groups stay IDB-only.
constraints: Do not start full-store Yjs migration in this slice.
Keep the spike isolated to the ideas store and validate concurrent panel-drag merge behavior.

context.notes: Roadmap section 3.1 is the next sync slice after facilitator mode.

tasks.title: 3.2 Full CRDT port for board stores
tasks.goal: Replace direct IDB writes across board stores with Y.Doc-backed mutations and ship a one-shot migration path from existing local data.
tasks.comment: Yjs is a storage rewrite, not a feature flag, so the port layer must hide the backend from UI and tool code.
definition_of_done: Storage helpers route through Y.Doc-backed mutations across the board stores.
First boot after upgrade migrates existing IDB data into the Y.Doc once.
UI and WebMCP tools operate unchanged through the storage port layer.
constraints: Do not keep a parallel IDB plus Yjs write path.
Migration must preserve existing board data and avoid two sources of truth.

context.notes: This follows the two-tab spike and should stay behind a clean storage port.

tasks.title: 3.3 WebRTC cross-machine sync with SDP-only broker
tasks.goal: Extend collaborative sync across machines by swapping BroadcastChannel transport for y-webrtc and adding the minimal SDP-broker room flow.
tasks.comment: The broker may pass SDP offers only; it must never carry Y.Doc payload.
definition_of_done: Peers can join a room across machines using a short room code or invite URL.
Remote sync uses y-webrtc instead of BroadcastChannel.
The signaling path carries SDP offers only and keeps idea payloads peer-to-peer.
constraints: Do not ship manual token-paste signaling.
Keep the broker minimal and avoid central storage of board contents.

context.notes: The roadmap explicitly rejects manual token-paste signaling even as a stopgap.

tasks.title: 3.4 CRDT-driven autonomous facilitator triggers
tasks.goal: Move facilitator triggers onto Y.Doc update events with idle gating, AI-host election, and AI-origin dedup so exactly one peer automates the board.
tasks.comment: This is the multi-peer follow-on to the current local-only facilitator and must stay human-interruptible.
definition_of_done: The observer subscribes to Y.Doc update events rather than local-only board state.
Exactly one peer claims AI-host responsibility via awareness-based election.
AI-originated transactions are tagged and deduped across peers.
constraints: Preserve global pause and bounded automation behavior.
Avoid duplicate ghost panels or repeated role runs during split-brain or host handoff.

context.notes: Peer-aware automation starts only after sync is real.

tasks.title: Stretch: search_local_docs local RAG tool
tasks.goal: Let the user grant a local docs folder and search PRDs/specs with File System Access-backed local retrieval surfaced as supporting-doc candidates or scout context.
tasks.comment: This is attractive, but the permission UX is the real blocker rather than retrieval code.
definition_of_done: A user can grant a folder and issue local doc searches from the app.
Matches surface as supporting-doc candidates or scout context rather than opaque raw snippets.
The app has a deliberate re-authorize flow for per-session permission loss.
constraints: Do not hide the File System Access permission boundary.
Do not assume persistent folder grants across reloads.

context.notes: The roadmap leans toward deferring this until the permission story is acceptable.

tasks.title: Stretch: cross_pollinate role and tool
tasks.goal: Introduce a dedicated cross_pollinate role that finds two distinct ideas and proposes a third merged concept with clearer intent than scout_ideas.
tasks.comment: This is partially covered by scout_ideas today, but splitting the role would sharpen synthesis-specific prompting and UI.
definition_of_done: A dedicated cross_pollinate role exists with structured output.
A WebMCP tool exposes the role on the standalone board surface.
The resulting suggestion clearly attributes the two source ideas it combines.
constraints: Do not duplicate scout_ideas behavior without a sharper synthesis contract.
Keep the output anchored to existing ideas rather than free-floating unrelated suggestions.

context.notes: This is a dedicated synthesis verb beyond the current scout behavior.

tasks.title: Stretch: declarative WebMCP + toolautosubmit
tasks.goal: Add agent-aware declarative form fields that emit tool calls on change when Chrome preview support is good enough.
tasks.comment: This remains blocked on Chrome preview validation, so it should stay behind the sync backlog.
definition_of_done: Declarative form fields can emit tool calls on change for supported surfaces.
The implementation is validated against the Chrome preview requirements called out in the WebMCP docs.
Unsupported environments degrade cleanly without breaking existing manual tools.
constraints: Do not ship this before preview validation is real.
Keep HTTP and manual tool invocation paths working without declarative support.

context.notes: Roadmap explicitly marks this as blocked on Chrome 146 preview validation.

tasks.title: Stretch: multi-user facilitator UX
tasks.goal: Once sync is real, add speaker tracking, consensus summaries, and end-of-session action-item capture that make facilitator behavior legible in collaborative sessions.
tasks.comment: This belongs after sync and peer-aware automation are stable enough to trust in shared sessions.
definition_of_done: Collaborative sessions surface facilitator-owned consensus summaries and action items.
The UX is designed for multi-user sessions rather than single-user board nudges.
The feature reads as an extension of the shared facilitator rather than a separate tool silo.
constraints: Do not start before sync and peer-aware facilitator plumbing are stable.
Keep the facilitator non-intrusive even in active discussions.

context.notes: This is explicitly downstream of the collaborative sync track.

tasks.title: Stretch: W1 external system integration tools
tasks.goal: Use the W1 active-tab tool path to let phase transitions write to Linear, Jira, or PRD tools with explicit second-step consent.
tasks.comment: This should extend the existing W1 consume path rather than invent a separate integration channel.
definition_of_done: The app can chain active-tab tool writes into supported external systems.
Phase-transition writeback requires an explicit second consent step.
The integration reuses existing W1 patterns instead of introducing a parallel bridge.
constraints: Do not bypass explicit consent for external writes.
Preserve the existing active-tab consumption architecture.

context.notes: This is the explicit W1 writeback stretch item from the roadmap.
